other_mijikenda: Mfudu shared with Duruma, Giriama, Swahili (Pakia)

teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'floury *mfudu*', because its purple-black fruit is mealier and starchier than the ordinary kind.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya '*mfudu* wa unga', kwa sababu tunda lake la zambarau-nyeusi lina unga na wanga zaidi kuliko la aina ya kawaida.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ra Chidigo rinamaanisha '*mfudu* wa unga', kpwa sababu tundare ra zambarau nyiru rina unga-unga zaidi kuriko ra aina ya kawaida.

summary.en: *Mfudu unga*, the black plum, is a deciduous tree of wooded grassland and forest edges with olive-sized, purple-black fruits. Its name sets it apart from its cousins in the *mfudu* group by the floury texture of its fruit.
summary.sw: *Mfudu unga*, au mfudu, ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa nyika zenye miti na pembezoni mwa misitu, wenye matunda ya zambarau-nyeusi yenye ukubwa wa zeituni. Jina lake linautofautisha na binamu zake katika kundi la *mfudu* kwa unga-unga wa tunda lake.
summary.dg: *Mfudu unga* (*black plum* kpwa Chingereza) ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa phatu phenye nyasi na mihi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye matunda ga zambarau nyiru, makulu dza tunda ra *olive*. Dzinare rinautafwautisha na nduguze, mihi ya kundi ra *mfudu*, kpwa unga-unga wa tundare.

about.en:
*Mfudu unga* is a deciduous tree with a rounded crown. Its leaves are made of five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand.

The fruits are about the size of an olive and ripen to a deep purple-black. Their pulp is mealy and floury rather than juicy, around a single hard stone.
about.sw:
*Mfudu unga* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye kilele cha mviringo. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono.

Matunda yake ni karibu ukubwa wa zeituni na huiva yakawa ya zambarau-nyeusi iliyokolea. Nyama yake ni ya unga-unga badala ya kuwa na maji, ikizunguka kokwa moja gumu.
about.dg:
*Mfudu unga* ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wenye makodza manji ga dzulu ga umbo ra mviringo. Chila kodza rina makodza madide matsano ganayoenea dza vyala vya mkpwono.

Matunda ni makulu dza tunda ra *olive*, na ganaivwa na kukala ga zambarau nyiru kabisa. Nyama ya tunda ni ya unga-unga, si ya madzi, na inazunguluka tembe mwenga ngumu.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and on forest edges. Look for its five-fingered leaves, and in season for the dark fruits on the ground beneath.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika zenye miti na pembezoni mwa misitu. Tafuta majani yake yenye vidole vitano, na wakati wa msimu wake, matunda meusi chini yake ardhini.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye nyasi na mihi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka. Uhendze makodzage genye vyala vitsano, na wakati wa matunda, uhendze matunda ga rangi nyiru photsi ya muhi.

culture.en: Pakia explains the name *mfudu unga*, 'floury *mfudu*': its fruit is starchier than the ordinary *mfudu*. Together with *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', the names show how the Digo sort related trees by the feel of their fruit.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza jina *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga': tunda lake lina wanga zaidi kuliko la *mfudu* wa kawaida. Pamoja na *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', majina haya yanaonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyopanga miti inayohusiana kwa kugusa na kuhisi matunda yake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza dzina *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga': tundare rina unga-unga zaidi kuriko ra *mfudu* wa kawaida. Phamwenga na *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa madzi', madzina higa ganaonyesa vira Adigo anavyoganya mihi ya ndugu kpwa vira matundage ganavyokala uchigaguta.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mfudu unga*. The shorter *mfudu* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. Note that Chonyi speakers use *mfudu unga* for a different tree, the chocolate berry (*Vitex payos*). In English it is the black plum, and its scientific name is *Vitex doniana*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu unga*. Jina fupi zaidi *mfudu* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Ikumbukwe kwamba wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi hutumia *mfudu unga* kwa mti mwingine, *chocolate berry* (*Vitex payos*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *black plum*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex doniana*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mfudu unga*. Dzina fupi *mfudu* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Ela manya kukala atu anaogomba Chichonyi anahumira *mfudu unga* kpwa muhi wanjina, *mfudu* (*chocolate berry*, *Vitex payos*). Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *black plum*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vitex doniana*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa matunda ya porini wa misitu ya wazi
